product_one_liner.value: BombBomb helps relationship-driven sales teams record, send, and track personalized video messages to build customer relationships.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes creating, sending, and tracking personalized videos, while its job posting identifies relationship-driven sales teams as the intended audience. Sources: https://bombbomb.com/company and http://bombbomb.applytojob.com/apply/P94nf0nbFB/Director-Of-Marketing

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists a per-user monthly price, directly establishing that a pricing page exists. Source: https://bombbomb.com/pricing

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports approximately 71 employees as of October 2026, which falls in the 51-100 band. This is a third-party estimate. Source: https://leadiq.com/c/bombbomb/5a1d8a6a240000240063c880

founded_year.notes: BombBomb's company page explicitly states that it was founded in 2006. Source: https://www.bombbomb.com/company

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents video-marketing, prospecting, customer-relationship, and product-use content. It does not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how BombBomb itself is built, so it fails the specified engineering-blog threshold. Source: https://bombbomb.com/blog/

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal provides account setup, OAuth, integration, webhooks, and API documentation rather than a single FAQ. Source: https://developer.bombbomb.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: BombBomb's public job board states that there are no open positions, which includes no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science roles. Source: https://bombbomb.applytojob.com/

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services (AWS), for automated video captions and transcription.
model_provider.notes: BombBomb's captions implementation article explicitly identifies an Amazon Web Services API as its chosen approach for automated captions and transcription. This supports AWS for that capability, but does not establish the provider of every newer AI feature. Source: https://bombbomb.com/video-captions

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public job board states that there are no open positions, so it lists no qualifying SDR, BDR, or account-executive openings. Source: https://bombbomb.applytojob.com/

launched_6mo.notes: The new-platform announcement specifies a November 9 migration and immediate early access. Its page metadata is dated October 22, 2026, placing this rollout within the requested window. New capabilities include browser-native screen recording and searchable transcripts, not merely cosmetic changes. The year requires combining the announcement with its timestamp. Source: https://support.bombbomb.com/hc/en-us/articles/49827659565965-New-BombBomb-Experience

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Kathryn Adamson's profile dates her BombBomb Vice President of Growth role to March 2026, within the requested twelve-month window. The evidence establishes the role's start date rather than providing a separate appointment announcement. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/kathrynadamson
